explanation: God's undeserved favor that grants people salvation without them earning it through their own works.
The concept of being saved from the punishment of sin and reconciled with God, which happens solely through faith in Jesus Christ.
Actions or conditions that violate God's will and create a separation between humanity and the Creator.
A description of the spiritual state before salvation, where people are without life in God due to sin.
The act by which God makes something new out of what was broken or dead through His power and grace.
The concept that Jesus Christ contains all things perfectly, so that nothing is lacking in Him for believers.
The concept of being reunited with God after a period of enmity caused by sin, achieved through Christ's death.
The act by which Jesus Christ removes the dividing walls between Jews and Gentiles to make them one people in him.
The concept that believers together constitute a holy place where God dwells by his Spirit, no longer limited to a physical building.
